svg.text: Juplaya trailer - power system physical layout
Plan view, looking down. Nose/front at left, rear/ramp at right. Curbside = passenger / awning / door side. Scale 1 in = 4 px (plan panels).
Roof PV - 3x LG455 in 3S (1365 W) -> SmartSolar 250/60-Tr
125" AC-aft -> rear rail = solar field (3 panels need ~123-124")
B Floor plan (top-down: curbside = top · roadside = bottom)
NOSE POWER BENCH (~18" tall) - all power gear + battery on edge -> detail C
bikes: nose-forward, via rear ramp - one rail roadside, one curbside (straddle CL)
Fiamma F45s awning case 138" + warm 24 V LED strip (curbside, at roofline)
C Nose power bench - real-scale layout
Front elevation of the ~18"-tall nose bench. All power gear + the battery (stood on edge) inside, to scale.
Front elevation - 56" W x ~18" H bench (seat top); battery stood on edge
One ~18" bench across the nose holds everything: the battery stands on edge (9.25" footprint, 12.32" tall) under the seat top.
Cabin face: 8260 + 6x 8282 switches + 6x 24V dimmers. Vent: low cabin intake + high fan exhaust (24V fan + thermostat).
Bench depth set by the battery on edge (~9.25") + wiring; hinged/removable seat top for service - confirm depth at dry-fit (D013).
Components (W x H x D, in):
* nominal/catalog. Battery, SmartSolar, Orions: datasheet. Flow/topology: see schematic (power-overview).
Anker SOLIX C1000 + PS400 - standalone 120 VAC camp island.
Optional ground-mounted 2S LG PV (910 W) + SmartSolar 150/35.
Sources: docs/power.md, docs/dimensions.md. This is the physical
layout; the electrical schematic is docs/diagrams/power-overview.*.
